answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each claimed identity to complete a Wesolowski VDF over a domain-separated challenge before acceptance. Its modular squarings depend sequentially on prior outputs, so GPUs cannot parallelize one chain to erase its latency. Clones may run concurrently, but each needs its own chain and hardware time; labels such as wharf, karst, and opal can distinguish challenges, not bypass this cost.
